SquadRoom.title: SquadRoom
SquadRoom.description: A private friend group chat room protected by a Secret PIN.

name.description: Display name of the squad chat room (1-60 chars).

adminUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the room creator/admin.

adminName.description: Display name of the room admin (1-60 chars).

pin.description: Secret PIN required on subsequent visits (4-12 chars).

memberUids.description: Bounded list of member UIDs (max 50) for local rule evaluation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when room was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when room was last updated.

RoomMember.title: RoomMember
RoomMember.description: Member presence and role within a squad room.

uid.description: Member Firebase Auth UID matching document ID.

memberUids.description: Denormalized bounded list of room member UIDs.

lastSeen.description: Server timestamp of last online activity.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Real-time message in a squad room supporting text, emojis, compressed photos, and video metadata.

mediaBase64.description: Optional compressed JPEG Base64 image or video thumbnail payload.

localMediaUri.description: Optional local content URI for video playback on sender device.

memberUids.description: Denormalized bounded list of room member UIDs.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was sent.

/rooms/{roomId}.description: Private squad chat rooms with Secret PIN and bounded member list.

/rooms/{roomId}/members/{memberId}.description: Real-time member presence and roles inside each squad room.

/rooms/{roomId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Real-time chat messages and media items inside each squad room.
